results.name: The M Riders
results.overview: An academy takes in kids with supernatural abilities. As they find their places in the academy, they learn to control their gifts. Soon, they realize that Earth is being invaded by dark forces and the school is gathering five M Riders to fight these forces. These riders are Ai Rui Ke, Princess Nai Ya, Mi Ya Xing and the two new students Li Yan Jian Ni and Lan Bao.

results.name: I'm in the Band
results.overview: Tripp Campbell is the new lead guitarist for Iron Weasel, a band that once ruled the world of 80s pop metal. Can he push the washed-up rockers out of his parents' guest room and back in the limelight?

results.name: The Big M
results.overview: A private detective investigates a protection racket and becomes involved in a murder case.

results.name: Sweet Punishment: I'm the Guard's Personal Pet
results.original_name: 甘い懲罰～私は看守専用ペット
results.overview: The story is set in a prison in the near future. It revolves around Hina Saotome, imprisoned despite her innocence, and the elegant yet sadistic guard Aki Myoujin. Hina's heart and body are at the mercy of Myoujin's "heartless yet sweet domination" from physical examinations to lovers' prison visits.

results.name: M&S: Dress The Nation
results.overview: 10 of Britain’s best amateur designers compete to win a dream job as a fashion designer at high street giant M&S hosted by AJ Odudu and Vernon Kay.

results.title: The M Word
results.overview: The 'M' Word" explores the themes of "menopause, men and menses".

results.title: The 'M' Word
results.overview: When Sarah begins to have doubts about her impending marriage to longtime boyfriend Jake, smooth-talker Nick makes his move. Meanwhile, Sarah's friends, Nicole and Cara, are also having romantic problems.

results.title: The Stoning of Soraya M.
results.overview: In 1986 Iran, Sahebjam, whose car breaks down in a remote village, enters into a conversation with Zahra, who relays to him the story about her niece, Soraya, whose arranged marriage to an abusive tyrant ended in tragedy.

results.name: The Mentalist
results.overview: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.

results.title: Blake & Mortimer: The Yellow M
results.overview: Europe, 1941. Nazi Germany develops the Omega Wave: a dangerous mind-control weapon capable of bending human will. MI5 Captain Blake and physicist Mortimer join forces to destroy it. The lab goes up in flames and the weapon is lost… or so they believe. Twelve years later, in 1953 London, a string of unexplained deaths grips the city. A shadowy figure known as “M” surfaces, armed with the Omega Wave. With the Queen’s coronation days away, Blake and Mortimer, two old friends, reunite on a deadly mission.

results.name: The Irish R.M.
results.overview: The Irish R.M. refers to a series of books by the Anglo-Irish novelists Somerville and Ross, and the television comedy-drama series based on them. They are set in turn of the 20th century west of Ireland.

results.name: THE iDOLM@STER Side M
results.original_name: アイドルマスター Side M
results.overview: 315 Production – a newly set up small talent agency – has assembled a group of aspiring male idols from various occupational fields. They include a former lawyer, a former doctor, former pilot and so on… Even though everyone hails from different backgrounds, they share a common dream: to be the top idol. And so, the stories of these male idols at 315 Production take centre stage…

results.name: Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H.
results.original_name: Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H.
results.overview: Joined by the Agents of S.M.A.S.H., a humorously dysfunctional group of teammates who double as family, Hulk tackles threats that are too enormous for any other heroes to handle.

results.name: I'm the Law
results.overview:
I'm the Law is the title of a 30-minute syndicated American television police drama series which aired in 1953 starring George Raft as Lt. George Kirby, a NYPD detective involved in solving a variety of crimes in New York City.

The series first aired on February 13, 1953 and ended on July 31, 1953.

results.name: I'm in Love with the Villainess
results.overview: The world turns upside down when a corporate drone wakes up as Rae Taylor, the heroine in her favorite otome game, Revolution. Rae is elated at the opportunity to court Claire François, the game’s villainess and the object of her affection. Armed with her knowledge of the game and events to come, Rae sets out to make Claire fall for her. But how will the villainess take Rae’s romantic advances?

results.name: I'm A Celebrity... The Daily Drop
results.original_name: I'm A Celebrity... The Daily Drop
results.overview: I’m A Celebrity…The Daily Drop brings you the latest gossip and exclusive content direct from Gwyrych Castle in North Wales. Joining presenter Vick Hope each episode are a stellar panel of ex-campmates and celebrity superfans who will delve, debate, and dissect all of the daily action from the camp.

results.name: I'm the Villainess, So I'm Taming the Final Boss
results.original_name: 悪役令嬢なのでラスボスを飼ってみました
results.overview: When her engagement to the prince ends unceremoniously, details of the young noblewoman Aileen's past life come rushing back and help her realize she's living inside the world of one of her favorite otome games—as the heroine's greatest rival! However, her memory has more plot holes than bad fan fiction…and the only certainty is that if she doesn't do something quick, her death is all but assured. The hero/main-love-interest can't be relied on, so why not see what the last boss has to say?

results.title: The Mongoose
results.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

results.title: I'm Beginning To See the Light
results.original_title: I'm Beginning To See the Light
results.overview: A tale of self-rediscovery seen through the eyes of a grief-stricken trumpeter, who finds salvation in a lighthouse and its two suicidal visitors.

results.name: I.M ON THE BEAT
results.overview: I.M ON THE BEAT it’s a music content and a program where people who does Hip-Hop/R&B can come out and talk about music.
